title: Ordered brown Unbleached but I received White bleached!! Carful what you order.  Big nice size.
text:
Ordered brown Unbleached but I received White bleached!! Carful what you order. Big nice size.. I like the large square size papers for my air fryer.
These seem thick.
I ordered the brown paper as it said it was Bleach Free, but I received the White!, which
I’m not happy using bleached white parchment paper to cook on.
They now say it’s food grade safe, but I have my doubts.

features: Food Grade Material: Our parchment paper sheets are made from food-grade materials and are 100% safe for use with food. They can withstand temperatures up to 428 °F and do not affect the taste of food. These disposable paper liners are suitable for use with air fryers, ovens, and baking pans.
Adaptable Size: These air fryer parchment paper liners fits for 5-8 QT air fryer, suitable for Instand, Ninja, COSORI, CHEFMAN etc.. Air fryer liner come within a box, ready to use and easy storage.

Extra Thickened: The airfryer liner is 45gsm,more durable and stronger than other's 35gsm baking paper parchment sheet, non oil water leaking.This quantity disposable parchment paper for baking can use for a long time.

Non Stick Easy Clean: These disposable paper liners can effectively keep food residue away from fryer and make it as clean as unused, Keep your air fryer clean,saving time and effort. These paper liners are must have if you hate cleaning after baking.

No Interfering with Internal Air Circulation: The heat is generated by air circulation from the pan's wall, and it won't affect the air circulation by using disposable paper liners. When baking, the grease comes out to the paper liner, giving you healthier foods.
